chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Where he lived in Harlem with his mother and wife
summary: He lived at several Harlem addresses on 111th Street and Edgecombe with his mother and wife.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Where were you living? Where was your home?
All over, 111th Street, 7th Avenue, 163rd Street and Edgecomb and 111th Street and Edgecomb. I had an apartment.
Were you living with your sister or were you living just alone --
With my mother, with my mother.
You and your mother and your wife?
